scene: The opened chest reveals travel passes to sunny places above.
picture: Along a wooden departure dock, a red street tram idles on the far left. The player in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands left of centre holding three tickets. In the centre, a wooden harbour ferry sits on green water. On the far right, a yellow cable car hangs at a dock gate.
shown: A red street tram waits on tracks at the far left platform.
A small wooden harbour ferry idles beside a pier at the centre.
A yellow cable car hangs ready at a gate on the far right.

variants.scene: Golden tickets inside the chest let you choose how to leave the cavern.
Holding your new pass, you hum {tune} while deciding your path.
Fresh journey passes give you access to three routes through the underground docks.
